Dzugutov.formula: V(r) = A * (r^-m - B) * exp(c / (r - a)) * Theta(a - r) + B * exp(d / (r - b)) * Theta(b - r)
Dzugutov.reference: M. Dzugutov, Phys. Rev. A 46, R2984 (1992); J. P. K. Doye, D. J. Wales & S. I. Simdyankin, Faraday Discuss. 118, 159 (2001)

mDzugutov.formula: V(r) = A * (r^-m - B) * exp(c / (r - a)) * Theta(a - r) + B * exp(d / (r - b)) * Theta(b - r)
mDzugutov.reference: J. P. K. Doye & D. J. Wales, Phys. Rev. Lett. 86, 5719 (2001)

Z1.formula: V(r) = (a * exp(alpha * r) / r^3 * cos(2 * kF * r) + b * (sigma / r)^n + v0) * Theta(rc - r)
Z1.reference: J. P. K. Doye, D. J. Wales, F. H. M. Zetterling & M. Dzugutov, J. Chem. Phys. 118, 2792 (2003)

Z2.formula: V(r) = (a * exp(alpha * r) / r^3 * cos(2 * kF * r) + b * (sigma / r)^n + v0) * Theta(rc - r)
Z2.note_on_table_I_typo: Table I of J. Chem. Phys. 118, 2792 (2003) prints b = 4.2e7 for Z2, a 10x typo for b = 4.2e6 (which yields the printed v0 = 0.13391543 and reproduces all 78 Z2 point files to < 5e-7).
Z2.reference: J. P. K. Doye, D. J. Wales, F. H. M. Zetterling & M. Dzugutov, J. Chem. Phys. 118, 2792 (2003)
